Fibre.Orbit.unfold: {ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} → (A → A) → A → Orbit A
Fibre.Orbit.mapO: {ℓ : Level} {A B : Type ℓ} → (A → B) → Orbit A → Orbit B
Fibre.Orbit._≈_: {ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} (B y : Orbit A) → Type ℓ
Fibre.Orbit.bisim:
{ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} {x = B : Orbit A} {y : Orbit A} →
B ≈ y → B ≡ y
Fibre.Orbit.path→bisim:
{ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} {x = B : Orbit A} {y : Orbit A} →
B ≡ y → B ≈ y
Fibre.Orbit.path≃bisim:
{ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} {x = B : Orbit A} {y : Orbit A} →
(B ≡ y) ≃ (B ≈ y)
Fibre.Orbit.path≡bisim:
{ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} {x = B : Orbit A} {y : Orbit A} →
(B ≡ y) ≡ (B ≈ y)
Fibre.Orbit.refl≈: {ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} {x = B : Orbit A} → B ≈ B
Fibre.Orbit.iterate: {ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} → (A → A) → ℕ → A → A
Fibre.Orbit.lookup: {ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} → Orbit A → ℕ → A
Fibre.Orbit.unfold-lookup:
{ℓ : Level} {A : Type ℓ} (B : A → A) (y : A) (p : ℕ) →
lookup (unfold B y) p ≡ iterate B p y
